This is the sixth public release candidate of the NPMplus Security Fork. It is intended for test servers before a stable release.

### What changed since RC5

- Integrated two rounds of upstream develop, including the rewritten upstream base: Argon2id password hashing with transparent legacy bcrypt migration on login, token revocation after password changes, MFA enablement, and backup-code regeneration, fresh session cookies on those self-service flows, cached per-user avatar/gravatar handling, initial-admin seeding through the regular audited user-creation path, and hidden Certbot errors now surfacing in the UI. Estonian and Azerbaijani locales are included.
- Added CrowdSec attack evidence: panels in attack history and active bans with suggested attack types, retained WAF rule names and request paths, detection windows, bounded same-IP honeypot context, and windowed WAF reporting per proxy host.
- Added Anubis challenge reporting: 1h/6h/24h/7d outcomes, a retained observation/ban-attempt ledger with IPv6 support, host/location coverage, and installer metrics collection without publishing port 9090.
- Added extended alert browsing with signed expiring cursors beyond the recent-history sample, IPv6 search/display coverage, and a read-only host firewall observer backed by bounded nginx counters exported over a private Unix socket and retained as five-minute deltas for seven days.
- Added a built-in Animated forbidden page (403) default-site option with reduced-motion support, a stylesheet-hash CSP and framing denial on the built-in forbidden page, and CrowdSec/AppSec access checks enforced before it is served.
- Cut hot-path overhead: permission validators are cached instead of rebuilt per request (the `users-*` permissions keep per-request rebuilds because they embed the calling user's id), nginx config rendering shares one Liquid engine with cached templates, and avatar/gravatar responses allow a five-minute private cache. SQLite connections now wait out transient write contention with a busy timeout and keep a 20 MiB page cache.
- Added enforced guardrails in CI: `tests/security-invariants.mjs` fails the build on drift in five load-bearing security properties, and HTTP-level characterization tests pin the merged session-revocation semantics.
- Hardened the installer through v1.58: honeypot bridge status with atomic publishing and preserved pending entries, Anubis reachability checks that survive oversized challenge bodies, separate public TCP listener checks, and lock-shared, writer-stopped restore with recovery on failure.
- Rebuilt the Caddy image against gRPC-Go v1.83.2 and re-verified every container with a fresh Trivy 0.74.0 scan; the fork Caddy image scans clean and the remaining upstream matches stay under the reviewed baseline expiring 2026-10-04.

### Install or update a test VM

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.6/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.6/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed test VM. Safe update repairs known configuration drift before the normal snapshot, health-checking, and automatic rollback protection. Existing RC5 test VMs should switch to this release before their next maintenance window. Note that the Anubis reporting, extended history, and host firewall telemetry additions require both the updated image and installer.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.

This fork is based on NPMplus by ZoeyVid and the original Nginx Proxy Manager project by JC21 and contributors. It remains licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later, with the original MIT-licensed work retained as documented in the repository.
